SELECT  
	ClientInstanceID=S.ClientInstanceID,
	Client=(SELECT CL.Name FROM CRS_ClientList CL, CRS_ClientInstance CI WHERE CI.ClientInstanceID=S.ClientInstanceID AND CI.ClientID=CL.ClientID),
	customergroup = (select cg.name from CustomerGroup CG WHERE customerGroupcode=:ar_custgroupcode),
	DocumentCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	Type='SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
	Date = S.Date, 
	Remark = (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode),
	Customer=c.Name,
	Cash = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	Aliasname=C.AliasName,
	Address=C.Address1,
	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM CRS_VirtualGL VirtualGL
			WHERE	
				(Virtualgl.Clientinstanceid = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid > 0 THEN :ai_clientinstanceid ELSE Virtualgl.Clientinstanceid END) AND
				VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.AreaCode,
	c.Area,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.RowID),
	VoucherCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=S.HeaderNo,
	Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty),
	Bonus=SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate=MAX(D.SalePrice),
	GrossValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice),
	Discount=
		SUM(D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
		SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
		SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * 
			(1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc)),
	ItemSaleTax=SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
	ItemValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
				(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
				(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
				(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
		SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
/*	MiscCharges=S.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=S.FlatDisc,
	InvSaleTax=T.InvSaleTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM CRS_SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ClientInstanceID = S.ClientInstanceID AND SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM CRS_SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ClientInstanceID = S.ClientInstanceID AND SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(S.CashCharged,0) > 0 OR ISNULL((SELECT SUM(M.Amount) FROM CashierWindow M WHERE M.SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode), 0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(S.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(M.Amount) FROM CashierWindow M WHERE M.SaleInvcode = S.SaleInvCode), 0) ELSE CASE WHEN S.SaleCatCode = 2 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END  END ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM CRS_SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ClientInstanceID = S.ClientInstanceID AND SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A, 
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE CT.CustCode IN (select custcode from customergroupdetail where customergroupcode=:ar_custgroupcode)) CT, 
		Area AR
	WHERE	A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
			AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C,
	CRS_SaleLedger S,	 
	CRS_SaleDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		SS.ClientInstanceID,
		SS.SaleInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsaleinvon') AS INT))) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsaleinvon') AS INT))) -
		(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
		SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc),
		InvSaleTax=	ROUND((SUM((DD.looseqty * 
			(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
			SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2),
		NetAmt=ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsaleinvon') AS INT))) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsaleinvon') AS INT)))
	FROM CRS_SaleLedger SS, CRS_SaleDetail DD ,
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE CT.CustCode IN (select custcode from customergroupdetail where customergroupcode=:ar_custgroupcode)) CT
	WHERE 
		(SS.Clientinstanceid = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid > 0 THEN :ai_clientinstanceid ELSE SS.Clientinstanceid END) AND
		SS.ClientInstanceID = DD.ClientInstanceID AND
		SS.Posted = 'Y' AND SS.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		SS.SaleInvCode = DD.SaleInvCode AND
		SS.CustCode = CT.CustCode AND
		SS.date  BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SS.ClientInstanceID,
		SS.SaleInvCode,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.FlatDisc,
		SS.InvGSTPerc1,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.MiscCharges,
		SS.SalesTax) T
WHERE   
	(S.Clientinstanceid = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid > 0 THEN :ai_clientinstanceid ELSE S.Clientinstanceid END) AND
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	S.ClientInstanceID = D.ClientInstanceID AND
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND 
	S.ClientInstanceID = T.ClientInstanceID AND S.SaleInvCode = T.SaleInvCode AND
	S.CustCode = C.AccCode AND
	S.date  BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
GROUP BY 
	S.ClientInstanceID,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.SaleCatCode,
	S.HeaderInvNo,
	S.HeaderNo,
	D.ICode,
	D.RowGroup,
	S.CustCode, 
	S.Date,
	S.DiscPerc,
	S.CashCharged,
	S.MiscCharges,
	S.SalesTax,
	S.FlatDisc,
	S.InvGstPerc1,
	C.AccCode,
	C.AliasName,
	C.Name,
	C.Address1,
	C.AreaCode,
	C.Area,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL

	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) FROM CRS_SRDetail SD 
		WHERE S.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(S.CashCharged,0) > 0 OR ISNULL((SELECT SUM(M.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin M WHERE M.DocumentType = 'SR' AND M.DocumentCode = S.SRInvCode), 0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(S.CashCharged,0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(M.Amount) FROM CRS_MasterCashWin M WHERE M.DocumentType = 'SR' AND M.DocumentCode = S.SRInvCode), 0) ELSE CASE WHEN S.SRCatCode = 7 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END END ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) FROM CRS_SRDetail SD WHERE S.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) 
		FROM CRS_SRDetail SD 
		WHERE S.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A,
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE CT.CustCode IN (select custcode from customergroupdetail where customergroupcode=:ar_custgroupcode)) CT, 
		Area AR
	WHERE	A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C,
	CRS_SRLedger S,	 
	CRS_SRDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		SS.ClientInstanceID,
		SS.SRInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsalereturninvon') AS INT))) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsalereturninvon') AS INT))) -
		(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) * (1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
		SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc)),
		InvSaleTax=	ROUND((SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
			SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2),
		NetAmt=ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsalereturninvon') AS INT))) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsalereturninvon') AS INT)))
	FROM CRS_SRLedger SS, CRS_SRDetail DD,
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE CT.CustCode IN (select custcode from customergroupdetail where customergroupcode=:ar_custgroupcode)) CT
	WHERE 
		(SS.Clientinstanceid = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid > 0 THEN :ai_clientinstanceid ELSE SS.Clientinstanceid END) AND
		SS.ClientInstanceID = DD.ClientInstanceID AND 
		SS.Posted = 'Y' AND SS.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		SS.CustCode = CT.CustCode AND
		SS.SRInvCode = DD.SRInvCode AND
		SS.date  BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SS.ClientInstanceID,
		SS.SRInvCode,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.FlatDisc,
		SS.InvGSTPerc1,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.MiscCharges,
		SS.SalesTax) T
WHERE 
	(S.Clientinstanceid = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid > 0 THEN :ai_clientinstanceid ELSE S.Clientinstanceid END) AND
	S.ClientInstanceID = D.ClientInstanceID AND   
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	S.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND S.SRInvCode = T.SRInvCode AND
	S.CustCode = C.AccCode AND
	S.date  BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
GROUP BY 
	S.ClientInstanceID,
	S.SRInvCode,
	S.SRCatCode,
	S.HeaderInvNo,
	S.HeaderNo,
	D.ICode,
	S.CustCode, 
	S.Date,
	S.CashCharged,
	S.DiscPerc,
	S.MiscCharges,
	S.SalesTax,
	S.FlatDisc,
	S.InvGstPerc1,
	C.AccCode,
	C.AliasName,
	C.Name,
	C.Address1,
	C.AreaCode,
	C.Area,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) > 0, '', IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) < 0, 'Cr', ''))
